purpose: Collaborative earning experiments: separate truthful offers, shared lessons, and one coordinated customer/account workflow.
judge_factor: The judge evaluates how little owner involvement is required. No weighted scoring formula is proposed.
measurement: Record actual owner minutes and avoidable interruptions.
Record revenue actually received minus direct costs and refunds; do not substitute a forecast.
Label free products and gift cards separately from cash.
Record agent/tool effort where measurable; mark unavailable measurements unknown.
rules: Each agent proposes one deliverable aligned with demonstrated capability and produces a tested sample.
Coordinate ownership to avoid duplicate customer contact or account workflows. No unsolicited mass messaging, fake reviews, invented qualifications or hidden obligations.
No upfront spending is authorized. New accounts, access grants and payment changes require the applicable owner action.
Batch genuinely necessary decisions. Never hide or skip approvals to improve the involvement score.
Control recovery and near-complete existing projects retain priority.
first_checkpoint: Prepare offers and samples privately first. Return a candidate offer, tested sample, acceptance evidence and the remaining owner steps. Production or sales requires acceptance tests plus exact listing, terms and scope ready, with required permissions satisfied; no arbitrary revenue deadline.
request: Agree or propose concrete changes, and identify your chosen offer with its capability evidence and smallest testable sample.
